Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the death date of James Kirkwood Sr. (the director) as April 21, 1989—confusing him with James Kirkwood Jr. The correct death date for James Kirkwood Sr. is August 24, 1963. This conflation would lead to an incorrect comparison of which director died first.
